verdict.rationale: Paddle documents an API reference and publishes an official Postman collection covering every operation, so users can "try the API interactively before writing code". It also publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec that can be explored in Scalar, Redocly, or Stoplight. However, this interactivity depends on external tools rather than an evidenced in-docs interactive reference with runnable examples. missing for 10: an evidenced built-in interactive "try it" API reference in the docs, runnable code examples embedded per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
